Import the SDK, create a client, send one message, and print the reply.

fields.code:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
msg = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-sonnet-5-5",
    max_tokens=300,
    messages=[{"role": "user",
               "content": "Hi!"}],
)
print(msg.content[0].text)

scenes.voiceover: Let's build a tiny Telegram bot in three steps.
Install the library, paste your token, and reply to every message.

fields.title: The whole bot
fields.code:
from telegram.ext import Application, MessageHandler, filters

TOKEN = "paste-your-token"

async def echo(update, ctx):
    text = update.message.text
    await update.message.reply_text(f"You said: {text}")

app = Application.builder().token(TOKEN).build()
app.add_handler(MessageHandler(filters.TEXT, echo))
app.run_polling()

fields.title: Весь бот
fields.code:
from telegram.ext import Application, MessageHandler, filters

TOKEN = "вставь-свой-токен"

async def echo(update, ctx):
    text = update.message.text
    await update.message.reply_text(f"Ты написал: {text}")

app = Application.builder().token(TOKEN).build()
app.add_handler(MessageHandler(filters.TEXT, echo))
app.run_polling()
